plugin-define-slot.name: Dictionary
plugin-define-slot.description: Definitions, pronunciation, synonyms, antonyms, and word origins for dictionary queries.

triggerMode.label: When to show
triggerMode.description: Keyword matches dictionary terms such as define, synonym, pronounce, origin, and meaning. Single-word also tries plain one-word searches.

maxDefinitions.label: Definitions
maxDefinitions.description: Maximum number of definitions to show.

maxRelatedTerms.label: Synonyms/antonyms per group
maxRelatedTerms.description: Maximum related terms to show per group (1–12).

definitionSource.label: Definition source
definitionSource.description: Choose English meanings from Free Dictionary API or Wiktionary. Pronunciation and origin requests still use Free Dictionary API.
